# Btown Beauty Supply & Salon

> Beauty supply & braid salon based in Bloomington, Indiana. A female-owned beauty supply and braid salon on South Rogers St. Braiding hair, gels, wigs and hair care on the shelves, and box braids, knotless braids, twists and installs in the chair.

## Services
- Braids & twists: Box braids, knotless braids, twists and kids' braids with beads, done in the shop with the hair right off the shelf.
- Wigs, color & extensions: Wig styling and color, lace front wigs and tape-in extensions, styled to sit right and look like yours.
- Beauty supply: Braiding hair, De Beaux Cheveux raw virgin hair, BTL braiding gel, wigs, caps, beads and hair care, plus soaps, oils and clothing. Shop online or call and ask what's in stock.

## About
Btown Beauty Supply & Salon is a local, female-owned small business at 805 S Rogers St in Bloomington, in business since 2011. Half the room is beauty supply: braiding hair, wigs, gels, hair care, accessories, soaps, oils and cute clothing. The other half is a salon chair where you can have your hair done by a skilled professional. For a lot of Bloomington customers it saves the drive to Indianapolis for braiding hair and supplies. The shop also carries its own De Beaux Cheveux line of 100% raw virgin hair bundles, frontals, closures and wigs. Call with what you need for your next hair project and there's a good chance it's on the shelf. It's a shop that supports and gives back to its community, and it's the kind of place where you walk out with what you came for and a good conversation.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Saturday, 11 AM to 6 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday. Holiday hours can change, so call (812) 361-6417 if you're making a special trip.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 805 S Rogers St, Bloomington, IN 47403, a few minutes from downtown and the IU campus.
- Q: Do you sell braiding hair?
  A: Yes. Kanekalon, pre-stretched braiding hair, passion twist and crochet hair, plus braiding gel, edge control and hair care. Call to check a color or length before you come in.
- Q: Do you braid kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' braids and twists with beads are regular work here, and the beads and clips are on the wall.
- Q: How do I book a braid appointment?
  A: Call (812) 361-6417 or use the booking form on this site. Tell us the style, length and size you want and we'll set up a time.
- Q: Do you sell virgin hair?
  A: Yes. The De Beaux Cheveux line is 100% 9A raw virgin hair in body wave, curly wave, spiral loose wave and super wave, plus frontals, closures and wigs. The online store lists them at $99 to $140.
- Q: Can I shop online?
  A: Yes. Hair and products are listed with prices in the Btown online store, and new arrivals go up on Instagram at @btownbeautysupplysalon. Call (812) 361-6417 to check stock before you drive over.
- Q: Do you do wigs and extensions?
  A: Yes: wig styling and color, lace front wigs and tape-in extensions.
